title: X11: Use unique abbrevs for the CallLists item fields
description:
Don't use a shared abbreviations for the CallLists lists fields
(which are FT_NONE) and for the individual items (which have all
sorts of types, including FT_FLOAT), because those are non-compatible.
Use unique abbreviations, and regenerate.

Fixes warnings about incompatible fields sharing abbreviations.
